_source: LingXi-internal feature — no upstream claude-code/src/tools/ counterpart. Locks derived from docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-24-m4-tools-implementation-design.md §7 lines 501-507 (M4-06 Team) + docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-23-m3-engine-completion-design.md (M3-02 team-mem path).
_note: M4-06 byte-aligned literals for 2 team-mem admin tools. Divergences documented inline: (a) safety check on Delete implemented as HARD REFUSAL (force opt-in) rather than soft warning (M4-04 destructive precedent). (b) admin create/delete does NOT consult settings.team_memory.enabled (the M3-02 watcher gate); team-mem provisioning is an admin action. (c) config.json body uses LingXi schema_version:1 — no upstream parity. (d) Tool event suffix `_completed` (M3-06 lock; spec shorthand says `_succeeded`). (e) ToolError::ValidationError variant does not exist; all semantic refusals surface as ToolError::InvalidInput, matching M4-05 task.rs precedent. (f) lingxi-memory dep would form a cycle (via lingxi-sidequery), so lingxi-tools mirrors the M3-02 TEAM_MEM_SUBDIR literal locally; the wire_identifiers.team_mem_subdir field asserts byte-for-byte equality with both.

error_string_formats.slash_or_traversal: Team: team_name '{team_name}' contains slashes or path traversal
error_string_formats.delete_not_found: TeamDelete: team '{team_name}' does not exist at {team_dir}
error_string_formats.delete_non_empty_no_force: TeamDelete: team '{team_name}' directory is non-empty ({file_count} files); pass force=true to delete anyway
